description:
The proposal consists of a single story rear extension to a lower ground floor Flat located at 29 A Fitzjohn's avenue, NW3 5JY. 
The proposals for the new rear extension are centred around providing more living space to the flat whilst at the same time ensure that good daylight is provided and overlooking is restricted. In response to the conservation area guidelines the design of the extension retains a view along the side to the property to enable glimpses of the garden beyond. The new extension will provide 34.6 sq.m of new gross internal area in a single storey with a flat roof to ensure its subservience to the main building.

The neighbouring flat 29B has a bedroom with two windows next to the proposed extension. The side window would be blocked by this proposal but the scheme proposes to increase the size of the bedroom window facing the rear of the property within an existing archway. This will enhance the quality of the light entering the bedroom.

Additionally, the proposal also includes a new balcony space for flat C above. Access will be provided through alternations made to an existing rear casement window. The new balcony will be the same width as the existing window. Following pre-planning advice the balcony will be painted steel. In addition, it is noted that the existing window will be able to retain it’s upper stained glass panels. Only the lower casements will need to be re-made so that they extend down to form French doors to the balcony level

The applicant for this proposal owns the Freehold of the whole property. In addition, they own the Leasehold of flats 29A, 29B at the Lower Ground Level and 29C at the Upper Ground Level.
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the end of three years from the date of this permission.

Reason: In order to comply with the provisions of Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended).

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:

336-100 Rev.C; 336-150 Rev.D; 336-103; 336-153 Rev.C; 336-101 Rev.B; 336-201 Rev.A; 336-151 Rev.C; 336-105; 336-155 Rev.B; 336-102 Rev.B; 336-152 Rev.C; 336-104; 336-202 Rev.A; 336-203 Rev.A; 336-204; 336-205 Rev.B; 336-000; 336-154 Rev.B.

Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interest of proper planning.
Condition : 3 - All new external work shall be carried out in materials that resemble, as closely as possible, in colour and texture those of the existing building, unless otherwise specified in the approved application. 

Reason: To safeguard the appearance of the premises and the character of the immediate area in accordance with the requirements of policy D1 and D2 of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017. 
Condition : 4 - Prior to the occupation of the development hereby permitted, the rooflight of the proposed rear extension shall be fitted with obscure glass and be non-opening, and the rooflight shall be retained as such for the duration of the development. 

Reason: To protect the privacy and amenity of adjoining occupiers and to comply with Policy A1 (Managing the Impact of Development) of the Camden Local Plan 2017.

Condition : 5 - Prior to commencement of development , full details in respect of the living roof in the area indicated on the approved roof plan shall be submitted to and approved by the local planning authority. The details shall include 
i.	a detailed scheme of maintenance 
ii.	sections at a scale of 1:20 with manufacturers details 	demonstrating the construction and materials used and showing a variation of substrate depth with peaks and troughs
iii.	full details of planting species and density

The living roofs shall be fully provided in accordance with the approved details prior to first occupation and thereafter retained and maintained in accordance with the approved scheme. 

Reason: In order to ensure the development undertakes reasonable measures to take account of biodiversity and the water environment in accordance with policies G1, CC1, CC2, CC3, D1, D2 and A3 of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017.
